evidence.item: AuthProvider listens for auth:logout and performs the only navigation to /login after local cleanup.
Frontend session is token-only and buildRequestHeaders injects Authorization only when an access token exists.
Refresh 400/401/403 invalidates local auth and emits auth:error without an infinite retry loop.
ProtectedRoute redirects unauthenticated users and logout-flow tests cover redirect after logout and auth:error.
Tenant is embedded in user state and used by the tenant filter hook.
Backend auth contract still includes login, refresh, profile, logout and logout-all.

notes: The JSON intentionally contains no passwords, tokens, cookies or Authorization values.
